body: Character reference sheet illustration, painted digital art style with confident linework (like a professional character-design turnaround, not a photo). A young Black man with short dark curly hair, an ear piercing, standing in a strict scarecrow T-POSE facing the camera dead-on: BOTH ARMS LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT HORIZONTALLY TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height, elbows perfectly straight, both open empty hands with fingers spread, a large visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso, nothing held, legs straight shoulder-width apart. REAL ADULT HUMAN PROPORTIONS (7-8 heads tall, NOT chibi, NOT stylized-short) -- an athletic normal build. A layered draped garment in gradient red-to-orange fabric (a large wrap/shawl draped over one shoulder and hanging asymmetrically to one side, NOT covering the arms or overlapping the torso silhouette), worn over a plain white t-shirt, loose red cargo-style harem pants with visible pockets, straps, and buckles, chunky red high-top sneakers with thick soles. Layered necklaces and a wrist cuff as accessories. Matte-painted cel-shading with soft gradients within the red/orange/white palette. Plain flat light-grey studio background so the silhouette reads clearly, full body visible head to feet, no text, no logos, no watermark
